notes.title: Dev Update #12 - Stay a while and listen!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/f5c50737ea42b79b4950abecfcb138f950a63fa4.png[/img]

[i]Hey there folks!

Hope everyone is doing all right out there. On our side we're hard at work with Act I, and we'll soon start cracking at Act II as well. Also, as we'll still be working from home for quite some time, here is a bit of love to our companions who now have to live with us all day long.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/3c9fc90c756005073af92391fef7d04f7dde45d9.png[/img]
[i]Gimli loves to invade our morning stand-up meetings with his peppy chirps.[/i]

[h2][b]April Contest - Design Your Magic Armor[/b][/h2]
Little reminder: [b]you still have one week to [/b][url=https://forums.solasta-game.com/forum/april-contest-design-a-magic-armor][b]submit your Magic Armor Design[/b][/url] for a chance to have it implemented in-game at launch! On April 28th, we will select our favorite submissions and the voting phase will begin! 

[url=https://forums.solasta-game.com/forum/april-contest-design-a-magic-armor][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/8ed1464f640c05286f2ee3d5a90e2c5786cc30e7.png[/img][/url]
[i]Time to craft your very own your magic armor in a video game![/i]

[h2][b]New Systems, Operational![/b][/h2]
[b]As our Designers work on creating fun and challenging levels, we have a constant need to create and implement new systems to make their dreams a reality[/b]. Well, I say that but sometimes it's something as simple as needing a door that opens when you activate a lever. Or a trap that activates when you walk on a tile. [b]Almost every interaction needs a system behind it[/b], which is why our Programmers will never be out of work! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/3206df32290bb16a0d963bb6fda08a207a9e3841.gif[/img]
[i]Step carefully now, fall damage is no joke![/i]

For instance, we have recently been playing around with [b]pressure plates[/b] - traps that only trigger when you step [b]away [/b]from the plate, and not when you step [b]on [/b]it. We've also implemented [b]gadgets that only react to [/b][b]magic - or even magic of a certain kind[/b] (such as spells dealing fire or radiant damage). Solving puzzles and opening secret doors won't be a simple matter of succeeding a Perception check! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/7a6a93e7a902d17394881476ef75f588e62f3e9d.gif[/img]
[i]Here are the new gadgets we were talking about above, ready to be used by our level designers![/i]

Systems aren't only needed to build levels, of course. Another example would be the [b]Party Banter feature[/b] that we promised in our Kickstarter Campaign, which just made its debut in-game! It still needs a lot of love and tweaking so that the party members aren't talking [b]all the time[/b] (trust me, it gets tiresome very fast), but at least adventuring will be a little more lively now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/795c845575a13f180ab9b2cace14910b5a87e460.gif[/img]
[i]Characters will react differently to their party members depending on their personality (and yes, it will be voiced!)[/i]

As we're talking about new systems, I'd say it's high time we give you a glimpse of our [b]crafting system[/b]! Now before we start, please keep in mind that[b] crafting is not a main progression system in Solasta. It's used to make useful items such as scrolls, potions and poisons[/b] - not forge magical artifacts of tremendous power (you're playing a party of adventurers, not a party of blacksmiths). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/eff2edc0da5ca492055f63f6e318679dd181dbc7.jpg[/img]
[i]"You youngsters and your healing potions! Back in my day, we drank herbal remedies and it cured everything I tell you. EVERYTHING!"[/i]

[b]Crafting is done during downtime when travelling[/b] - after setting up camp, adventurers can devote time to various activities before going to sleep, including crafting. Still, remember that as with anything else we're showing you in our Dev Updates, [b]all of this may change in the futu[/b][b]re[/b] as Crafting is still in its infancy in Solasta. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/f5c50737ea42b79b4950abecfcb138f950a63fa4.png[/img]
[i]"Can we do a long rest yet? What do you mean we did one just before this fight, my character likes to sleep a lot alright?"[/i]

We've also been working on [b]adding merchants to the city of Caer Cyflen[/b]. You can see here that your relation with certain factions will now come into play when bartering with them, as a [b]bad reputation may result in shopkeepers raising their prices[/b]. The opposite may also apply and who knows, they may even have some special items in the back of their shop for you...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/9434536f1a678c45a9dbe640e4ebc66c4823f8df.jpg[/img]
[i]"Hugo, listen to me. I didn't mean to stab him, I thought he was a bandit you see? Now can you stop gouging your prices?"[/i]

[h2][b]Caer Cyflen Wasn't Built in a Day[/b][/h2]
Speaking of Caer Cyflen, [b]its empty streets are slowly getting filled with life[/b]! It's a long process, but we're confident that it will look fantastic when we're finally done with it. We'll even have citizens walking around soon - that may not sound very impressive, but currently every NPC in town is just standing around looking like a tree so hey, progress!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/8b37c017ab8902589a1e0ca36cc2cad21bfc4d41.png[/img]
[i]"My dear, you must absolutely tell me where you got pennants that are so white." "Oh, those are just missing their texture."[/i]

We've also worked on what towns and locations will look like on the[b] World Map[/b] which, again, changed quite a bit since the last time we showed it to you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/92ad0f697f6a00837ecdb1249b9b2a1842590a81.png[/img]
[i]This world map is getting more and more eerie at night, isn't it. [/i]

Also, since we're talking about towns... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/9c770aa38e3216465197e18d8a2adfe899f1b51c.jpg[/img]
[i]What is it? Where is it? You'll see...[/i]

[h2][b]It's a Kind of Magic[/b][/h2]
The great thing about spells in D&D is that there are plenty of them. The bad thing about spells in D&D is that there are plenty of them - wait what? Jokes aside,[b] it can be very hard for new spellcasters to choose between all the spells that are available to them - which is why we've added filters on our Spell Page[/b] for you to easily find the right spell to prepare for the right occasion! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/c5511d061ec3e10caab29a25dcf5893f053150a1.jpg[/img]
[i]Maybe I'll finally stop preparing only concentration spells too, it didn't work too well last time I did that. [/i]

Our VFX artist has also added [b]Levitate [/b]and [b]Knock [/b]to Solasta. Who said we only show flashy destructive spells? Feast your eyes on these!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/157f731f09f69355fad005cf967254e3350e5b2d.gif[/img]
[i]Something something "Open Sesame". I'm out of bad joke slots for the day, need a long rest.[/i]

[h2][b]Bloopers![/b][/h2]
As it is often the case, our bloopers this time are once again a result of our Animator breaking things. Although this time he was helped by our Graphic Programmer in his quest to make our NPCs as derpy as possible. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/fab585ef1269903cecbd01fdf7b748d182a9938c.png[/img]
[i]"No, being able to look at two directions at once does not grant you advantage to Perception."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/c1f9a2535084de1cee5d01a759ec9a09442a905d.png[/img]
[i]OH MY GOD WHAT IS THAT.[/i]

That's it for today! Hope you enjoyed our Dev Update, don't forget to participate in the [url=https://forums.solasta-game.com/forum/april-contest-design-a-magic-armor]Magic Armor Design Contest[/url] if you haven't already!

[b]Read our previous articles here:[/b]
[list]	[*]		[url=https://www.solasta-game.com/news/48-dev-update-2-dungeons-dwarves][/url][url=https://forums.solasta-game.com/forum/april-contest-design-a-magic-armor][April Contest] Design a Magic Armor[/url][/*]	[*][url=https://www.solasta-game.com/news/71-dev-update-11-day-night-cycles]Dev Update #11 - Day & Night Cycles[/url][/*]	[*][url=https://www.solasta-game.com/news/69-dev-update-10-new-gameplay-footage]Dev Update #10 - New Gameplay Footage![/url][/*][/list]

notes.title: Dev Update #11 - Day & Night Cycles
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/06db4e969777ddffc2d17090fc68e91e62f3bd70.png[/img]

[i]Hello everyone,

Are you ready for the first Dev Update of April? Well you better be, for we have tons of things to show you![/i]

[h2]Community Magic Weapon Contest[/h2]
Annnnd stop! [b]With 32% of the total vote, the Arcane Shieldstaff wins [url=https://forums.solasta-game.com/forum/march-contest-vote-for-the-community-magic-weapon]March Community Contest: Design your Magic Weapon[/url][b]![/b] Second place goes to the [b]Manacalon Javelin of Sure Returning[/b] (21%), followed by the [b]Winged Dagger[/b] (17%), the [b]Mace of the Midday Sun [/b](16%) and finally the [b]Mountain Breaker[/b] (14%). Huge congratulations to our winner [i]GreyWarden77[/i], the runner-ups [i]Woolynelson[/i], [i]Maruo Sartori[/i], [i]Ithron [/i]and [i]Shadow of Olympus[/i], as well as everyone else who participated to the contest. We will soon be sending Forum Badges as a reward to all participants - as well as some bonus XP so you can level up and get access to more avatars!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/dd4a4823a8ec1cfba707e6f49218148f342555a4.png[/img]
[i]Bronze for participating, Silver for getting selected, Gold for 2nd place, Diamond for winning![/i]

We've also been informed that the [b]Arcane Shieldstaff[/b] looks similar to the [b]Staff of Defense[/b] found in the [i]Lost Mine of Phandelver[/i] D&D 5e module. However, [b]it doesn't grant a +1 Bonus to AC, and it can also cast Shield as a Reaction[/b] (Staff of Defense can only cast Shield as an action). Oh and it also doesn't have a 5% chance of blowing up every morning, we can already imagine the amount of bug reports about "Items disappearing from Inventory" if we did that. 

That being said, [b]thank you for staying vigilant and telling us about these kind of issues [/b]- if we do conclude that it's too close to an existing item in the end, we may change it slightly while keeping the intent intact (so it won't suddenly be doling out fireballs by the dozen, but it may trade [i]Mage Armor[/i] for a [i]+1 to All Saving Throws[/i] for instance)

[h2]Day & Night Cycles[/h2]
You might remember us showing you a little sneak peek of the Day & Night cycle when talking about our new World Map screen in early February ([url=https://www.solasta-game.com/news/62-dev-update-7-adventurers-clad-in-pink]Dev Update #7[/url]). For those who missed it  - or who simply forgot, it's been 2 months after all - here it is!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/822e9597e329d3bfd513c4a64be702e736758446.gif[/img]
[i]You can even see the clock at the top showing the passage of time![/i]

Back then, you were only able to see the changes in luminosity on that specific screen... But it is no longer the case! [b]When your party is inside a location, time keeps going[/b] - so when you do a short rest or a long rest (1h / 8h), you will see the level change with the time of the day. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/255dc16450ed118ef6a61516e7cda5fea3cd8ad0.png[/img]
[i]Before / After a long rest, from 10:50 am to 6:50 pm (8h)[/i]

Now for the fun fact: even when you're not doing rests, the [b]time is actually flowing in real time[/b]. That means if you were to leave your computer with Solasta running for a few hours (without being in a menu), you may very well come back and see that the luminosity now looks a lot different! This should almost never happen if you're just playing normally, but just for fun here is what it looks like with a (very) accelerated video. As you can see, [b]it's not just a question of having one "Day version" and one "Night version" [/b]of the level - the luminosity changes with the in-game time! [b]It's also important to note that the changes aren't only visual[/b] - after a certain hour, you will be fighting under Dim Light conditions - and who knows, maybe even in total darkness!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/6a7782c63ed4609ddf8d5c28ddf585a20a7da07c.gif[/img]
[i]Once the night hits, you better have those torches and Light spells ready![/i]

Alright, hope you enjoyed it! All of that was made possible thanks to our Graphic Programmer, who made a [b]fantastic tool[/b] for the team to play with!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/b547858ccdfb950d349c76d57600a1d5a7bf2fbd.gif[/img]
[i]Most of his work can be considered as MakeThingsPretty.exe for our Dev Updates[/i]

[h2]Random Encounters![/h2]
Don't you love it when you're traveling back to town from dungeon-delving, half-dead and completely out of spell slots - only to be hit by a random encounter? Well, now you can experience these rage inducing moments in Solasta as well! That's what you get for culling down the locals, you damn murder hobos. Anyway, [b]random encounters - they have now been implemented in the World Map, and you can even get ambushed under certain conditions[/b]. This means we've also been working on a small encounter map - and will probably end up making a few more so that you don't always fight "random" encounters in the same "not so random" location ([i]damn it Fred, I told you we should have gone around that clearing, we've been ambushed the last 5 times we went through here![/i]) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/c6e4ea6004a5e62196811f9715ebf3ebfc965d06.jpg[/img]
[i]Hey look guys, more XP and loot to entertain us during our journey![/i]

[h2]New Levels in the Work[/h2]
We've been showing you a lot of the same locations slowly being improved - which is fairly important considering those are the first levels which new players will be seeing - but I'm thinking some of you might want to see [b]some new locations[/b]. Well, here is a little something for you - although we won't be telling you where that is! [b]Always keep in mind that all you're see here is Work In Progress, [/b]it's far from being done!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/850e9f422ad76400ad6384298469f41b25a124fd.jpg[/img]
[i]Ohhhh toasty. Did things get a bit heated over here, or did the wizard just drop a fireball to clear the area?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/320688a5cc1bf8611f0266aa7e8a4606c4f7cfd0.png[/img]
[i]"Mellon"! "Mellon"! Damn it guys, it's not working.[/i]

[h2]Concept Art & Icons![/h2]
Time to show some love for the Art Team, who've been kept busy working on... icons. Lots and lots of icons, for all kinds of stuff! Turns out that when you want your Character Creation to be free of placeholders, there are plenty of little things you need to take care of - Divine Domains for Clerics, Fighting Styles for Martial Classes, Spells for Spellcasters, Archetypes for everyone... Anyone, here it is - once again, not everything is final so some of these icons may very well change in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/e986933246b575a38e08a66c33befe49375e69e1.png[/img]
[i]We finally have an image for the Acolyte Background! With this, all 8 Backgrounds are now ready[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/cb21897d9d6cb7c401369c4d957c7178f7609d00.png[/img]
[i]First version of divine domains & some extra archetype icons[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/8c3ab5227ce16f4ba358b86ee97656856a26261d.png[/img]
[i]First version of crafting component icons (ooohh crafting... another topic to discuss sooner or later!)[/i]

[h2]VFX Corner![/h2]
Today's a good day for VFX lovers. Why, you may ask? Well, how about... [b]Fireball[/b], one of the signature spells of D&D? Feast your eyes now, before you grow weary of it after spamming fireballs at every issue you find in your way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/1478ac8b508df175d614e7d35de2425c94f7dad0.gif[/img]
[i]How do level 5+ wizards deal with their problems? EXPLOOOOOSION![/i]

However, it wouldn't be fair if we only showed Violet all the time. Here is Vigdis with a brand new Solasta-flavored power: [b]Channel Divinity - Holy Retribution, from the Law Domain[/b]. When you lose HP from an enemy melee attack, you can use your reaction and Channel Divinity to immediately <s>smack that impudent swine</s> strike back with some added psychic damage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/e5aa855a31e277535eeb593845cd0d03c7055b0a.gif[/img]
[i]RETRIBUTION, HERETIC! IT TASTES LIKE VICTORY![/i]

[h2]Bloopers![/h2]
[b]Unfortunate as it is, no blooper this time[/b]. There weren't so many funny bugs as there were unwanted crashes, and error messages aren't the most entertaining screenshots to share. So instead, here's a rejected helmet design doodled by our Lead Animator during our last Sprint Review.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/8597bff58724da331c146c6e0fed52b35de2b166.png[/img]
[i]A giant spoon for a helmet? Someone fire this man right now.[/i]

That's it for today, [b]April Community Contest is right around the corner![/b]

notes.title: Dev Update #10 - New Gameplay Footage!
notes.content:
[i]Hey there everyone,[/i]

[i]The current situation may not be ideal, but it’s not going to stop us from making our scheduled Dev Update! We hope you’re all doing well out there - on our side we’ve all switched to working from home. The good thing about being a small team is that it makes us a bit more agile, so we’re still able to make good progress on Solasta as we speak![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/89e8fc87b41f8f2723e9f5078275cb4c88281ec9.jpg[/img]
[i]As you can see our productivity remains unaffected. [/i]

[h2][b]March Contest - Design Your Magic Weapon[/b][/h2]
Little reminder: [b]you still have one week to [/b][url=https://forums.solasta-game.com/forum/march-contest-design-a-magic-weapon][b]submit your Magic Weapon Design[/b][/url] for a chance to have it implemented in-game at launch! On March 31st, we will select our favorite submissions and the voting phase will begin! 

[url=https://forums.solasta-game.com/forum/march-contest-design-a-magic-weapon][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/9e394467fbe33eedf974afe2a9bb9163f8cc9cc4.png[/img][/url]
[i]Don’t miss your chance to make your magic weapon a reality in Solasta![/i]

[h2][b]Solasta Alpha Footage![/b][/h2]
[b]We all know it’s been forever since we’ve released gameplay video footage of Solasta[/b] outside very short gifs in our Dev Updates. Thing is, you always wonder: when is your game "good enough" to show to the world? Is the lighting too strong here? Does this bug really look bad? Will people understand that X and Y are temporary? So on and so forth.

[b]However, with the Steam Game Festival: Spring Edition making its sudden [/b][b]appearance [/b]and Solasta’s Pre-Alpha Demo once again being available (although not anymore, the event ended yesterday morning), we wanted to make sure people understood that the game had evolved since our Kickstarter. [b]This is why we made a short video bundling quite a few previously unavailable features on Twitter last Friday, which you can enjoy in Full HD here.[/b]

[u][b][url=https://www.solasta-game.com/storage/cms/BuUxZG2Q1GOLi4ygn6O76Tqc3hv7GdKsIAweV6hp.mp4]Click here to watch the video![/url][/b][/u]

[h2][b]What is this Spell?[/b][/h2]
[b]One feedback that stayed with us ever since we released our Kickstarter Demo was that Spell Icons were not clear[/b]. You would look at your spell bar and go "alright, I’m pretty sure my cleric should have cure wounds, but where is it..."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/b439be762c46a9b981875521de526df7727d325d.png[/img]
[i]Aside from a few of them that are fairly obvious, would you be able to name all these spells from their old icons alone?[/i]

While they all looked quite beautiful (at the very least I really liked them), our Art Director decided to change the art style of our spell icons - to improve glance value and readability. [b]Here is a side by side comparison of a few of these spells, which are all going to receive the same treatment in the coming weeks. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/3eb59ca9e7ef47021bbacb3f383ab7373dd6243f.png[/img]
[i]It’s hard to deny that the new ones are much easier to recognize.[/i]

[b]Speaking of spells, we’ve just added Fog Cloud to the game[/b]. Time to obscure those lines of sight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/4b29b47e18ea57544facfda9dc60a5ee043c6e32.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Character Creation Update[/b][/h2]
You’ve seen quite a few updates on our Character Creation Tool, and today’s Dev Update is not going to be the exception! [b]Our goal is to have it completely done soon, so we can set it aside and focus on other parts of the game. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/c291e51ae9c04c72c9a7bc0c19f5ad4d1d58e842.png[/img]
[i]The High Elves join the fray in our Character Creation Tool...[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/ff1540235947a3c550e2d251fc02b12b3501cc3d.png[/img]
[i]And so do the Half-Elves![/i]

[b]Now all that remains are [/b][b]the Island Halflings and the Hill Dwarves[/b], and we should have a complete lineup for our races!  

[h2][b]Environment Update[/b][/h2]
One Snow Alliance Embassy, ready to go! Here is how it looks in-game compared to its original Concept Art.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/c83fc79899a903754f3a674e51acd14a37d4734f.png[/img]
[i]Pretty impressive rendition of the original 2D concept art, isn’t it! [/i]

We’ll also share with you a couple of screenshots of an external location that your party will have to explore fairly early in their adventure. Watch your step, you don’t want to fall in that ravine... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/31405ad6b6a6c2f1587629d79805ef07ef772ce2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/c3790a3f8748955446de5ea8d613d24c01d24219.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Giant Eagles Join the Fight![/b][/h2]
Our second flying enemy just joined the roster of foes you’ll have to face. [b]Give giant eagles a warm welcome![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/5c9229d4779977e921282447364ddfc3bd6a1b45.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/3049b24d60784137afe14aafda67b591df98f885.gif[/img]
[i]Tactical Adventures assures you that no eagles were harmed in the making of these gifs.[/i]

[h2][b]Bloopers![/b][/h2]
You may have noticed the lack of Thunderwave so far in our Spells FX updates. Truth be told, we did have Thunderwave in-game (you may remember it was available in our Pre-Alpa Demo) - but [b]the format wasn’t quite right[/b]. The spell was automatically centered around the caster, which a few players made sure to inform us about! [b]So we fixed it. And by that I mean, we introduced a new bug while doing so. [/b]Here is a little demonstration of what happens after you get hit by Thunderwave.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/f7aa14ba2e37f74d75996c7c719bf61d97789555.gif[/img]
[i]Weeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeh![/i]

[b]We also just hit 2,000 followers on [/b][url=https://twitter.com/tct_adventures][b]Twitter[/b][/url], which was the perfect occasion for me to sneak behind the back of our Producer and ask our Lead Animator (father of many horrible and hilarious gifs) for a little something for the occasion. And trust me, he delivered! Alas, poor goblin - you were never supposed to do things like this. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/12cad3bbcd3034d4e9f3fb889bf5e32a9019c19b.gif[/img]
[i]Goblins doing thumbs-up, check. I may yet win this bingo game. [/i]

That’s it for today! Hope you enjoyed our Dev Update, see you next week for more Solasta goodness!

notes.title: Dev Update #9 - Flinging Spells at the Environment
notes.content:
[i]Hey hey friends! February’s Vote is over, it’s time for us to open the lid and count the votes![/i]

[h2][b]Choose your Monster[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/b1611ac7ed1ea0aa261eabf1fa579a6d43a3d029.png[/img]
[i]Let’s just hope you won’t regret it when you see it charging towards you in a narrow corridor[/i]

[b]With a staggering total of 50% of the votes, the Minotaur wins [url=https://forums.solasta-game.com/forum/february-vote-choose-your-monster?page=1]February’s Community Vote[/url] by a huge margin![/b] In second place, we have the [b]Ettin with 20%[/b] of the votes, followed by the [b]Troll with 16%[/b] and the [b]Ettercap last with 14%[/b]. Minotaurs will thus join the monster roster of Solasta, prepare to face them in deadly encounters. With the ability to charge and gore anyone in its path as well as being able to attack recklessly as much as they want, [b]Minotaurs will make for tough foes to defeat![/b]

[h2] [b]Did Someone Say... Monsters?[/b] [/h2]
It’s easy to forget that it takes quite a bit of finishing touches to have a monster be 100% ready for the final game. And by finishing touches, I don’t mean making it look prettier (although it’s always nice) - I mean that there are a lot of "little things" to take care of. One of them, for instance, is their [b]portrait for the initiative tracker[/b] during combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/6803712906250b9953fe4588ba851ef77b005a94.png[/img]
[i]The reign of random Google Image placeholders is finally over![/i]

Speaking of placeholder icons, if you've never seen what some of them can look like, I invite you take a look at [url=https://imgur.com/r/Dota2/CuIrM]this wonderful gallery of placeholder icons for DOTA 2[/url] - let it be known that Valve has some very humorous artists. Also, do you know what else is important? [b]Audio - and especially audio timing[/b]. Imagine your character hitting an enemy... only to hear the impact about a second later. There are few things that can be as grating as audio delay, and it completely destroys game immersion. This is why one of our Programmers worked on[b] a little tool[/b] for our Audio Engineer to visualize the different animations and help them time the audio more easily! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/8474569dce8b12c00ba670af5ecb8689f5b762a1.gif[/img]
[i]And we’re still improving it! You can check plenty of things with it, not just monsters.[/i]

Also, little fun fact (if a little useless) that I forgot to mention last time: [b]our Flying Snake’s tail is dynamic.[/b] That means if it suddenly froze in the air, the tail would still dangle for a bit (because physics). That also means you could technically make it wiggle very hard, something I have no doubt our Lead Animator already did. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/b66c658585a4d0717e3d734467afa65b61b6fb9e.gif[/img]
[i]Danger noodle, wiggle wiggle![/i]

[h2] [b]Flinging Spells at the Environment [/b] [/h2]
[b]We usually don’t show much about our Programmers’ work[/b], for a very simple reason: there isn’t really anything to show. Lines of code don’t really make for good screenshots after all. [b]But [/b][b]today’s an exception[/b] - we’ve long been working on it, and we’re finally implementing [b]interactions between spells (and powers) and the environment![/b] It might seem like such an obvious thing, but a monster, a door and a torch are far from being the same thing. [b]There are different systems at work behind each of those elements[/b], and not everything reacts in the same way... That is, [b]unless you want some poorly optimized game or very weird things to happen.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/50b8fdbcba3cd223fb390f0a74b7b63d342e7d0c.gif[/img]
[i]One of the earlier iterations of Spells / Environment interaction, you can see an older version of the combat grid[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/0711a2fdeb66ca50167b7f0e4ef5667d2e965d41.gif[/img]
[i]Doors are no longer safe from Wizards. Open, sesame![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/6b37d4b7a01ca15cd56598ff53c87dfe88f95b17.gif[/img]
[i]You can now light torches with Fire spells, and extinguish them with Water & Ice spells (we’re still discussing that choice)[/i]

[h2] [b]Character Customisation is Getting There![/b] [/h2]
We’ve been showing you all these cool haircuts and beards in the past Dev Updates; you’ll be happy to know that [b]we’re slowly implementing them in-game[/b]! Soon enough you’ll be able to make a colorful party to travel the lands of Solasta. Farewell, Violet, Garrad, Rhuad and Vigdis, and hello[b] new adventurers with custom faces[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/e0ba7ac937fdf9072f558dea1023bd1ef2928aa2.gif[/img]
[i]We’ll show you some other races in future updates as well![/i]

[h2] [b]More Architecture, now in 3D![/b] [/h2]
We’ve showed you plenty of concept art for buildings and details in the past updates - but what do they actually look like in 3D? Let’s take a look at the [b]Snow Alliance Embassy[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/727819f1d043bd4f2532b1564181d3026d85f842.jpg[/img]
[i]Here is the concept art of the facade of the Snow Alliance Embassy[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/04839a2d2ffec14bceb7bdbdaf0bb2dc24a5a35b.png[/img]
[i]And here are the 3D models of the window, the arches and the pillars. Pretty faithful, eh?[/i]

On that topic, [b]we’ll share a more in-depth article about the city’s playable area in the near future[/b]. We know it’s something that a lot of you are curious about, since a game’s main hub is somewhere you spend quite a bit of time after all! [b]Currently we’re working on the Embassy District[/b] - and not only the buildings, but also the ground and the rest of the environment. Here are a few screenshots I’ve managed to nab!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/be6f3115c5a2881f7042337a3fa7146fcef4a8d4.jpg[/img]
[i]As a reminder, here is the concept art of the Embassy District that we shared quite some time ago[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/5178b93fe1516cb1acf4f8c0e92bceb6da1ed7a0.jpg[/img]
[i]Here is the same camera angle, but this time in-game (Work In Progress of course). It’s sorely lacking vegetation for now![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/e4fa35ed3ee8f2c66e279f835b1f81a187af6d12.jpg[/img]
[i]And here is the promontory, overlooking the... well, I guess the lack of city since it hasn’t been merged in the main branch yet[/i]

[h2] [b]Bloopers![/b] [/h2]
Woohoo, blooper time! Remember when I was talking about having [b]armors adapt to the character’s shape[/b]? Well, here is what happens when the settings aren’t working properly. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/0297ba8bcad6fba3f018cccaeef25048524168d4.gif[/img]
[i]Adding eldritch horrors to Solasta, check[/i]

Here is another hilarious bug that we ran into (and that we shared on our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/uu8utaF]Discord server[/url] some time ago) [b]when working on traps[/b]. There’s some time loop shenanigans at work here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/f121e0cf12fe6abd7a18dc884a7e5973a351075d.gif[/img]
[i]This test level was aptly named "Tower of Pain"[/i]

That’s it for today! Hope you enjoyed our Dev Update, see you next week for [b]March’s Community Contest[/b]!

notes.title: Dev Update #8 - Choose your Monster & More!
notes.content:
[i]Hey there folks!

How have you all being doing? We want to start off this Dev Update with a big congratulations to [b]Kiaradth Bright-Spark[/b] (submitted by Jackobake), winner of the Mayor of Caer Cyflen Contest. Look forward to meeting her in-game! And now, before jumping into the Update, it's time for the next Community Choice...[/i]

[url=https://forums.solasta-game.com/forum/february-vote-choose-your-monster][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/c720e3193cb1a229855e3f19db93f679048e8599.png[/img][/url]

We did it once during our Kickstarter Campaign, and we're doing it again! [b]It's time for you, our future players, to [url=https://forums.solasta-game.com/forum/february-vote-choose-your-monster]choose which of the following four monsters you want to see added to Solasta[/url] at release.[/b] In an ideal world we'd want to have all of them, but Game Development is all about making choices to stay within schedule and budget!

[url=https://forums.solasta-game.com/forum/february-vote-choose-your-monster][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/a946f4d0a0385c0b312ff8bb6f03f1fdfb818ef4.png[/img][/url]
[i]Each of them are more than eager to have some adventurers for dinner![/i]

So which will it be? The mighty Minotaur, the towering Ettin, the undying Badland Troll or the treacherous Ettercap? Choose wisely, as you will be the one facing these foes! [url=https://forums.solasta-game.com/forum/february-vote-choose-your-monster][b]Click here to vote now![/b][/url]

[h2]Fetch me my Armor![/h2]
It might seem like a tiny thing, but [b]swapping armors around is actually not that simple when you have characters with different sizes and shapes[/b]. Just imagine dumping Garrad's massive armor onto poor little Violet. It... wouldn't work so well. For those who may not know who we're talking about, Garrad was our Human Fighter and Violet our Halfling Wizard in our Kickstarter Demo - you can check out the characters' size difference from a screenshot of our old opening cutscene to the Ruins of Telema below. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/afa4de7caf5834e577db20702fe90eb8b44dc390.png[/img]
[i]Nostalgic isn't it? This dates from even before our Kickstarter Campaign - you can see old haircuts that we removed since as they kind of looked like plastic.[/i]

As you can see in the image above, simply changing outfits between characters would produce terrible, terrible results. Even Rhuad, our elven rogue, would have trouble with that metal armour since he's much thinner than his bulky warrior friend. However, these days are now over. We have the technology! [b]Armors and clothes now fit to all our body templates and for all races[/b]. Don't let anyone tell you how to dress! You do you buddy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/35c2caab8d4f59b865dc8b3895e32d598af297fd.png[/img]
[i]Violet can now dump all her stat points into Strength and Constitution if she wants, she is no longer restricted to her wizard's outfit![/i]

[h2]On Lore & Architecture[/h2]
Rome wasn't built in a day, and neither is Caer Cyflen. Our game's main city is still under construction, although we're seeing more and more streets and houses, and less and less giant gray lego boxes as time goes by. Still, a picture is sometimes worth a thousand words, so I'll sneak in a small screenshot of an area we recently added to the game - keep in mind everything you see is still very much work in progress!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/1fc3bdd0e32b8bb7dc7de2a1764618015456b4d5.png[/img]
[i]"Hello? Anyone here? What do you mean, we haven't added the NPCs yet!"[/i]

We also know that there are some of you who very much like to see Concept Art and details behind how we make our environment feel alive and coherent in Solasta, so I've prepared a bundle of what our Environment Artist usually receives when he starts working on a new building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/7156c8c7990165eb9bb21c873acf524c5c93f381.png[/img]
[i]Each of these images are of course in much higher resolution, but if we started uploading those we'd quickly run out of space for our Dev Update[/i]

And for all our Cleric players out there, we've got a little something for you too! Our Art Director recently finished going over the different deity symbols, which you can check below. We will also be doing a little lore article going over each Solastan god in a bit more detail soon, so keep your eyes peeled for that!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/366ca26feca6142750be26b015e1326611f9c560.png[/img]
[i]Time to play the domain guessing game![/i]

[h2]Watch the Skies![/h2]
Verticality is one of the pillars of Solasta - we've said it time and time again, we want you to think in 3D when it comes to battles. But it just wouldn't be fun if the players were the only one able to use that verticality now, would it? This is why we're proud to present the first flying foe to make it in-game: the poisonous and terrible Flying Snake!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/4ec429b14b25c5ccb4bdaa5a2bcd4ac70e3bd6f8.png[/img]
[i]Isn't it somewhat adorable? No, no it is not. [/i]

notes.title: Dev Update #7 - Adventurers clad in pink
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/8e07dcc95c776a0df249ea310024bd445e4b25a6.png[/img]

[i]Hello dear readers!

How are you doing? It's February already, and we're starting to iron out the first few hours of our campaign. Let us share with you some of the new stuff we've added to the game! Also, don't forget that [url=https://forums.solasta-game.com/forum/vote-for-the-mayor-of-caer-cyflen-january-community-vote-part-2]the votes for the next mayor of Caer Cyflen[/url] are still going strong! If you haven't already, make sure you do your civic duty and [url=https://forums.solasta-game.com/forum/vote-for-the-mayor-of-caer-cyflen-january-community-vote-part-2]go vote[/url], citizen of Solasta.[/i]

[h2]World Map - Traveling the Badlands[/h2]
Back in mid-November 2019, we shared with you [b]a concept art of our World Map[/b] - which would be used to go from location to location. For those who may not have seen it or simply don't remember, here is what it looked like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/f8a8e05defc3aaad65459e450d301800a2e01658.png[/img]

Today, we're happy to show you [b]the first iteration of the World Map... in-game[/b]! Of course, there are still tons of adjustments and polish we need to do, but it's finally here and it's functional. Next step, implementing random events and encounters!

[url=https://www.solasta-game.com/storage/cms/q1Vb4yEkidP4z9RoCDUbPseZoyX0Io7OTKdvDoXM.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/822e9597e329d3bfd513c4a64be702e736758446.gif[/img]
[i]And we're experimenting around with the Day & Night cycle as well! Click for a longer gif[/i][/url]

[h2]Say That to my Face![/h2]
If you paid attention to all our screenshots so far, you might have noticed (DC 10 Investigation Check) that we're always using Garrad, Violet, Rhuad and Vigdis. And to a lesser extent, Lena and Dek - the two scavengers you met at the entrance of the Ruins of Telema. This was mostly because we didn't make any additional faces yet, as we were mostly focused on creating new monsters, doing research on armor and the like. [b]However, these days will soon be over![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/afc44ac2b10be0233b19eee5f657a0e65c3fef4b.png[/img]
[i]Here are a few of the upcoming faces for PC and NPCs! And don't worry they won't all be bald, we'll have hair too I promise.[/i]

[h2]Pink Adventurers, Assemble![/h2]
New faces are not the only things we're adding these upcoming days; [b]we're also bringing new armors and clothings onboard[/b]! Adventurers will soon be able to select from a new and improved range of armors, as well as remove their protection without going nude. Not that running through the prison tutorial with a nude character wasn't funny the first few times, but we're pretty sure it would a bit of an issue if we were to release the game in that state. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/ad5f991299026ca932436ab0a66d9597f3c08295.png[/img]

You might be wondering: "Why are they all pink?" The answer is pretty simple - we still need to add some textures! Not that we dislike the color mind you, but I don't believe adventuring in a shiny pink armor would help with those Stealth checks. [b]Here is an example of what they should look like[/b] after we're done adding textures:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/0d43cba1aec4fafdbeb23cb77a47e341e68e7dc8.png[/img]

[h2]Working on Cutscenes [/h2]
[b]Cutscenes have always been an important part of our game[/b], as we wanted to avoid throwing lengthy block of texts at our players every time they encountered a new NPC. Note that some games out there do the latter very well - we're not saying it's a bad thing per se - however it is not what we're going for. This is why we've been doing a lot of work to improve our cutscenes: tweaking facial expressions, experimenting with more camera angles, looking out for tiny details that would sometimes throw characters into the uncanny valley... We're no AAA studio, but you can be sure that when our community shares negative feedback with us, we'll lend an ear and attempt to fix the issue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/586f87f8208853d90b9abe06aae80cee4cc141a9.png[/img]
[i]Ignore the toilet paper tubes on the table, we shall have real ale mugs soon enough.[/i]

[h2]The Official Forums will soon Level Up! [/h2]

What's this nonsense? [url=https://forums.solasta-game.com/]The forums[/url]? Level up? 

That's right! We wanted to add a bit of flair to [url=https://forums.solasta-game.com/]our good old forums[/url], and in the coming weeks we will roll out an update to allow you to gain XP when commenting, level up to gain new avatars, and get fancy titles and trophies for participating in contests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/735a109b43b81692ff19f3e417995712e9e267c9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/fbe636d05fac39382904facd16848f354a650b6a.png[/img]
[i]Here are all the avatars you'll be able to unlock once the update goes live![/i]

[h2]Bloopers![/h2]
Ahhhh, we're finally done with this week's Dev Update. Or are we? If there's something I've been wanting to do for a long time now, it's to share a few bloopers every now and then showing [b]the... little mishaps of development[/b]. Small screenshots of bugs that are shared in the company's chatroom, gifs of random tomfoolery (often driven by our Lead Animator, much to everyone's delight). I hope you enjoy them as much as we did!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/cbfcbbd60fdf61e153b51a75866e32f8442120c4.png[/img]
[i]For some reasons the NPCs bugged out and were all lying face down on the ground, making the cutscene a little awkward[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/ba71ce91c1e41687c15ccc0c77d22ca3c202b5ec.gif[/img]
[i]Our Lead Animator, happily sharing the results of his latest script[/i]

That's it for today! Hope you enjoyed our Dev Update, see you next week for the result of [url=https://forums.solasta-game.com/forum/vote-for-the-mayor-of-caer-cyflen-january-community-vote-part-2]the Mayor's Vote[/url]!

[i]Article by Tactical Myzzrym[/i]

notes.title: Dev Update #5 - By Sword and Shield!
notes.content:
[i]Hello there folks!

Hope you all had some wonderful time over the winter festivities, rolling dice and singing merry songs. Wondering about when you would finally be able to play Solasta. Well I'll have to apologize, the time has not yet come for us to reveal that information. That being said, boy oh boy do I have a bag full of goodies for you! Santa may have already returned to his icy lair, but the Tactical Adventures crew is here all year long.[/i]

[h2]Art Direction - Research & Concept Arts[/h2]
There's often one little thing that you'll find in all great RPGs, and that is attention to details. We've said it before during our Kickstarter and we'll say it again: when we create items and props for Solasta, we want it to be coherent - it is a world with its own identity. There has to be logic behind its architecture and decor, and it is a very important part of our researches to make Solasta truly come to life. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/b680086fb5866dcc511c119af87dd715a12fff42.png[/img]
[i]We hold Solastan architects to very high standards, those who do not make the cut are banished into the Badlands. FOREVER![/i]

But you're not here for that, are you? No no no, you sneaky adventurers are here for the shinies and the loot, yes? Well here is a compilation of our most recent Armor & Clothing Concept Art for you! Will you be able to recognize all of them? Give it a try!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/a2676fbdc548ff8adb3d37bb4ec353a32f77c651.png[/img]
[i]A big thanks to Dummy McGreyface and his family for helping us show off these new clothes (which are not exclusive to elves by the way). [/i]

[h2]UI & Icons[/h2]
As promised, Paladin & Ranger have now joined the fray! You will now be able to select these classes in our Character Creation screen, and for this occasion we have created the icons that will represent them when choosing your class.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/802e1af14560e68fcff55e01ca64b0fc981ad889.png[/img]
[i]I sure hope I don't need to tell you which image is for Paladin and which is for Ranger. [/i]

And that's not all! Martial class lovers rejoice, our Fighting Style Icons are now available as well. Don't hesitate to print those onto your D&D Character Sheets to look cool for a few sessions before your inevitable reroll after getting pulverized by a poorly timed critical hit. If you managed to save your party's Cleric, turn to page 86 to pat yourself on the back. If not, it's unfortunately a TPK: go back to page 1 to start your adventure again. Damn these books were great.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/2ee8e9a6ce59215a3d2efdb83a1b2f91d8e66195.png[/img]
[i]Can you recognize them all? And yes two-weapon fighting is missing, don't worry we just... forgot to create the task. No, really. Sometimes it's that simple.[/i]

[h2]Monsters & Enemies[/h2]
We've shown you our little Goblins running around, now watch as they fight and die for our sadistic pleasure. When you think about it, adventurers are pretty scary - running around stabbing people. Why yes, monsters are people too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/a9058a67ad7d6b65331e08fcab2607de679e5c10.gif[/img]
[i]Eric? Eric, nooooo! Look at you, who's the monster now![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/0564f57068c186bb4b4387f74316f3c9bdef09bc.gif[/img]
[i]Get them, boys! Revenge for Eric![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/46ecb047051c18f39474adf8afc6d01eda2e70cf.gif[/img]
[i]Don't you even think about running away! We'll catch you![/i]

Alright alright, that's enough Goblins for today. Why don't we show something else now, say... wolves? Good old wolves. Classic RPG encounter, you can't go wrong with a pack of wolves. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/39faa71482e4e198427640ff0db197d3b3d0848c.gif[/img]
[i]Awww look at him go! Who's a good doggy! Yes you are![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/9c9f10fbbd85d085841538968fe9a6cd6aef22bd.gif[/img]
[i]Mere obstacles won't stop this wolf, I tell you![/i]

[h2]Spells[/h2]
As usual, let's end today's Dev Update with a new spell effect! You can click on the gif to watch the high-quality MP4 version of the clip.

[url=https://www.solasta-game.com/storage/cms/zs1Wgogy3z4Pvr2rbhlBce7debHOQjy1As6jjUc9.mp4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/2e07d41e4ceecce7435ee97d8cf1307e656b1ed5.gif[/img]
[i]Darkvision[/i][/url]

[i]Article by Tactical Myzzrym[/i]

notes.title: Dev Update #3 - Winter is here, and it's cold!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/357f66eeae75044922f5aa7e173bd1f30305ced4.png[/img]

[i]Hello dear readers!
December's here, and that means we have yet another batch of amazing stuff to share with you. Take a chair, grab a cup of coffee (or hot chocolate) and let us tell you of the newest developments in Solasta. [/i]

[i][b]Important Note:[/b] As a reminder, everything you're about to see is Work In Progress! That means some of it may look clunky, janky, broken, empty, ugly - and even if it does look "okay" or pretty good, it's not final (so it will look even better in the final game)! Also the design is not final, so things may work differently once the game goes live. [/i]

[h1]Art Direction - Research[/h1]
What do you show new players when they enter the Character Creation screen? Sometimes, seemingly simple questions like these bring up quite a lot of discussions. Do we go for simplicity with a static, cool-looking concept art of the party? [b]Wait... how would that work since the player is supposed to create his four characters from scratch?[/b] Who do we show on screen in that case?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/51c177348b52b698307402e12b4dadb5c42367fa.png[/img]
[i]Research on a dynamic Character Creation landing screen (sketch), which would display the 3D models of the characters you create.[/i]

While we're still early in development and everything can be subject to changes, our Art Director proposed to go with a [b]dynamic landing screen[/b]. By default, you would get four pre-generated characters on screen - and clicking on one would take you to the Character Creation screen where you can switch them with your very own creation, [b]changing the Character Creation screen accordingly every time you swap party members[/b]. 

Speaking of Character Creation, our Concept Artist has started working on a [b]wide variety of haircuts, beards and moustaches! Note that haircuts and facial hair can be chosen separately, they are not linked together. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/de57a54d0497f3155be8273e2a4727f275795bd5.png[/img]
[i]Picking up adventuring comes with a complementary trim at the nearest barber shop.[/i]

[h1]Monsters & Enemies[/h1]
We've talked a lot about adventurers and their ilk, but what about the true citizens of Solasta? Those who are shunned by the more "advanced" societies just because they happen to enjoy a little bit of violence and murder. Discrimination, that's what. Of course, [b]it would be hard to have a good High Fantasy setting without the classics. Orcs... and Goblins![/b] You've already met your friendly orc neighbours in the Ruins of Telema (and perhaps even enjoyed a fair few rounds of fisticuffs, they do so enjoy physical activities), so prepare to greet our Goblins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/a8bb6e714a92291c4f980b5dde1db4f5769c8c47.jpg[/img]
[i]Beautiful. Now that's a face that'd make any seasoned adventurer swoon. [/i]

Now that their 3D models are done, our lead animator Grégoire ([url=https://www.solasta-game.com/news/50-tldr-7-a-primer-on-animating-solasta][u]who was the guest of our previous article on Animation[/u][/url]) is going to spend a good chunk of time bringing them to life! [b]Walking, running, attacking, dying... There's plenty to be done.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/ed3a01740ce9f61271e97cd45bb0a4ee773815aa.gif[/img]
[i]Little known fact: Goblins can actually fly by wiggling their ears very hard. Not.[/i]

Aside from Goblins, our Concept Artist has also worked on bringing some wildlife to the world of Solasta. [b]Behold the wolf![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/e2fea7b313adb01f61dbac39241b57720a407ed6.png[/img]
[i]Who's a good boy? Who's a good pupper! Yes you are! [/i]

[h1]Environment & Levels[/h1]
Our Art Team wasn't the only one hard at work, as [b]our Design Team has been working on some new levels that you'll get to enjoy[/b]. We don't want to spoil too much by giving away location names or showing too much of the level itself, but here are a few gifs to enjoy.

[url=https://www.solasta-game.com/storage/cms/9mhEZd3of5cs5NG5vjDfPXmvnCx2SvNP0PfhXwbw.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/c0b9015d2c7e6682134f1b7874b06589a11cb553.png[/img]
[u][i]Gif too large for Steam, click to view[/i][/u][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/3fbc61e57182076dae8493a82c3847ec1d0dd6a4.gif[/img]
[i]Watching your neighbors over the fence as they are doing a barbecue and didn't invite you.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/67fe9c4d1df832c5285cae436dd69f8b0fba6647.png[/img]
[i]Orc Totems Concept Art.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/a0c99030915e7c2a48d737546ba27bcbf21f2576.gif[/img]
[i]Close-up of the totem in-game.[/i]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
One of the much needed features that we couldn't implement in time for the Kickstarter Demo was [b]a functional 3D Map of the level[/b] so that players wouldn't get lost in the level. We haven't forgotten about it, and we are now testing a new version that's already working much better than the previous one. Note that it still looks very rough for now, and we plan to remove some elements to improve its readability. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/e0173d4019f5a828812d46d08cbdf8c5d551ede3.png[/img]
[i]You'll be able to move the map around, zoom in and maybe even fast travel from there. [/i]

[b]We've also created a tool that adjusts the water level of the ground[/b] to add muddy pools and make humid caverns look more realistic! Hopefully those are tools that will be available for the community once the Modding SDK is made public.

[url=https://www.solasta-game.com/storage/cms/thq1X88RqyxqdjpUzFN1XtGcHqvtTHPPcnbPvKA4.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/cd83a1d4d49c6029443b817a0e0e04398b38e67e.jpg[/img]
[i][u]Gif too large for Steam, click to view[/u][/i][/url]

[h1]Animations & Special Effects[/h1]
We're now reaching the end of today's update, which was packed with a lot more visuals than usual! I picked a few spells and animations from our FX artist and lead animator for the finale - we like to leave the best for last.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/95375f7f1f21642cd41dcf2b7762263a7fd3e54a.gif[/img]
[i]Rapier attack animation, minus the rapier since we still need to make it.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/e469d19461da25a54b1925ab61487943dafea885.gif[/img]
[i]Barkskin Spell Animation[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/4759b7c792156c137b3bbafae7376ba4fa76f2d1.gif[/img]
[i]Hold Person Spell Animation[/i]

That's it for today! [b]Among what you've seen today, what made you the most excited?[/b] Please do drop a little comment below as we always enjoy reading your messages :)

[*] [url=https://www.solasta-game.com/news/48-dev-update-2-dungeons-dwarves][u]Dev Update #2 - Dungeons & Dwarves[/u][/url]

notes.title: Dev Update #1 - Goodbye Telema!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/d7a7cdc60446363cf0f36b0ebe6c657f416a03bd.png[/img]

[i]Hello there folks!
It's been quite some time since we last showed you what's going on behind the scenes, hasn't it? Worry not - I have you covered. So, what have we been up to since the end of our Kickstarter campaign?[/i]

[b]Important Note: As a reminder, everything you're about to see is Work In Progress![/b] That means some of it may look clunky, janky, broken, empty, ugly - and even if it does look "okay" or pretty good, it's not final (so it will look even better in the final game)! [b]Also the design is not final[/b], so things may work differently once the game goes live.

[h1]Main City[/h1]
There's one question that has been asked quite a few times during our Kickstarter: "Is Solasta a pure dungeon crawling game?" If you've been following our updates, you'd likely know the answer is no! [b]We actually just started working on the main city[/b] - which will remain unnamed for now as we don't want to spoil too much. We're still evaluating how much of it will be open for you to visit, we'd hate to pour too much time into that and end up having to cut other locations as a consequence. For those of you out there who are wondering - [b]yes, there will be a tavern[/b], for what's a city without one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/90b68f5f6f304d0a07bca07a336dbbf68245608a.png[/img]
[i]Now throw in some NPCs, add some alcohol, a player party. Baby, you got a brawl going.[/i]

[h1]Campaign Introduction[/h1]
[b]It's no secret that most games nowadays need tutorials to ensure that the player understands how the game works[/b]. This could be as simple as [b]pointing out elements in the UI[/b] (for instance, many people complained they couldn't find the "Rest" button in the Demo), or as complex as [b]explaining the rules of combat[/b] to someone unfamiliar with the tabletop ruleset (Action, Bonus Action, Reaction...). So, in order to do that without boring our future players to tears, we've been working on including those during our [b]Campaign Introduction Levels[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/9deb732e6055246822cbd7586e56c0ff81567e35.png[/img]
[i]The prison we showed before is in fact one of the Campaign Introduction Levels![/i]

[h1]Game Design[/h1]
There's quite a lot we still need to refine in terms of rules and how everything works in Solasta. For instance, we've been working on [b]Design Documents[/b] on two significant topics that weren't part of the Demo: [b]Traveling & Random Encounters[/b]. What is revealed on the World Map (more on that later!) and what isn't? How do you travel to undiscovered locations? How do other RPGs handle traveling? This is but a tiny glimpse into the mass of questions we have to find answers to when we put a design onto paper in order to avoid wasting time coding something and realizing afterwards that... well, it just doesn't work (or it does, but it's not fun). 

Other topics we've been tackling include [b]climbing[/b] (how high can you climb? What affects the DC?), [b]sleight of hand[/b] (can it be used for something other than stealing? What happens if you get caught?), [b]rethinking the inventory system again[/b] (by the end of the project I think fingers won't be enough to count how many times we've revamped the inventory) and... [b]Party Banter[/b]! (Kickstarter Stretch Goal)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/8e7a22d800de94d7e2e8aeb08ca1938d2fc3c826.png[/img]
[i]Hope you brought some good climbing equipment! (Mock-up Image)[/i]

[h1]Tools & Gadgets[/h1]
Tools and what now? When you're creating a level, [b]you need tools and gadgets to do what you want[/b]. Sometimes, it's something as simple as saying "This door can be lockpicked" or "When I activate this lever, I want that door to open"... but the simple things are often the most crucial ones! So, our Programmers make sure that our Level Designers get what they need - as once they make the gadget, our Level Designers can use it as much as they want. Now some of you might already have an inkling of a larger picture here... [b]If I said modding, would that help?[/b]

Wait wait wait, what does this have to do with modding? Well, if and when we release modding tools, we want people to be able to easily make more dungeons and levels - and that's where all these tools & gadgets come in. [b]Everything we add for our Level Designers, we want Modders to be able to use it later on.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/5b44409ec280abbe2d7fc4f25950dd3991bf1dca.gif[/img]
[i]A retractable door? And I get to troll my companions with it? Oh boy![/i]

[h1]Invisible Work[/h1]
Designers & Artists often get to show off their work with pretty screenshots and gifs, but Programmers? They work in the shadows, carefully biding their time before they can finally OVERTHROW THE TYRANNY OF... Sorry where was I? Ah yes, Programmers. Among other things that you cannot see, but are very important, they've been making [b]improvements on all types of movement[/b] (Jumping, Climbing, Crawling...). Because yes, even little things like your character going prone to crawl through a duct automatically when you click on it needs some programming love behind it. Otherwise you'd be stuck with manually having to tell your character to go prone, then crawl, and then manually telling your character to stand back up. Ugh.

[b]Fun fact, our CEO also implemented Character Creation[/b]! If you remember the [u][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tacticaladventures/solasta-crown-of-the-magister/posts/2633781]Kickstarter Update[/url][/u] where we showed you a sneak peek, back then everything was on paper - now we can actually create a character in-game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/2642a62476d8faeb0d1b1d4b28a3878c8c7140ca.png[/img]
[i]Either our QA Lead is extremely lucky, or she's been using weighted dice.[/i]

[h1]Art Direction - Research[/h1]
Some things in life are just unfair. Like your car refusing to start in the morning when you're already late, your colleague taking the last bag of tea right before you, or that guy getting a better roll on that item you've been trying to get for weeks. Another thing that's unfair is how good our Art Director's work looks compared to all the other images that show up in this Development Update. Without further ado, let me share his [b]research work on Incantation Circles[/b] that will appear when you cast spells. He's also been working on a [b]runic alphabet[/b] which we'll keep to ourselves for now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/bf172567cb3785fd56086c8e969dc3938d285a7d.png[/img]
[i]We'll show you the rest of it at a later date[/i]

[h1]Character Models[/h1]
You know what's the best thing about getting a new Race thanks to Kickstarter? We get to show more cool pictures from our Art Team. Here is some [b]concept art for the Half-Elf (Man & Woman)[/b], from which our 3D Artist will create the future in-game models. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/b6ca3b9730827e597bae530f42319055a5b2199a.png[/img]
[i]We might end up reworking our Elves a bit to further differentiate Half-Elves from Elves[/i]

Of course that's not the only thing they've been working on - we've moved forward on quite a few topics, such as adding [b]new haircuts[/b] to see how they interact with Character Creation and various hats / helmets, or finally getting our Dwarves some [b]fabulous bushy beards[/b]. On a side note, you wouldn't believe all the wonderful things you can do by duplicating beards to cover various part of the body. We've spent a very productive morning [url=https://www.solasta-game.com/storage/cms/rpZBq5uTEs0a1wvDFIW12tcRW36IXcFuluq2AIyw.png][u]laughing over screenshots[/u][/url] sent by our Graphic Programmer. More seriously, we've also done [b]research and concept arts on the outfits of the common folks[/b] of Solasta - yes, NPCs need clothes too, who would have imagined?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/fdcea9cdc3ba851694fda7c0d3fce86ccf44e4f5.png[/img]
[i]Finally some good facial hair![/i]

[h1]VFX[/h1]
Tired of reading yet? Well, let's end this week's Dev Update with some VFX. [b]Remember how spellcasting used to look in the Demo? Well, prepare to be amazed![/b] Reminder, this is still a work in progress. You might notice there's a lot of flashy effects for Burning Hands, so the "base version" (spell slot level 1) might be a little less grandiose in the final game. [b]You can click on the GIFs to watch the high-resolution MP4 video instead.[/b]

[url=https://www.solasta-game.com/storage/cms/9qp3QTAcGLAdesVOvUBQlkRO8MgKicMoVCJQPnQn.mp4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/b1df779224364f1c7ed355a8804d62770c92fd3e.gif[/img]
[i]Roasting some spiders with Burning Hands[/i][/url]

[url=https://www.solasta-game.com/storage/cms/2KXOruYIsLU1cYJDhTmJHDg6I3wlJJrG6R02PL99.mp4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/42d73ae828a7da0b04074bfa4d164c944e79bb6e.gif[/img]
[i]Reaction - Casting Shield[/i][/url]

[url=https://www.solasta-game.com/storage/cms/pPPKmIlzIgMSPys1OIyLybatFB7PJoivDAj1GVqu.mp4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/42d2e7a279de2717d8343e770face67992f8d0c4.gif[/img]
[i]Reaction - Casting Featherfall[/i][/url]

There's a ton of additional work we haven't covered in this Dev Update, such as [b]Environmental Research & Modelling, Animations and Cutscenes improvements[/b] - but I believe this article is already long enough, so we'll talk about these another time! Don't hesitate to drop by our [u][url=https://www.solasta-game.com/discord]Discord Server[/url][/u] or [url=https://forums.solasta-game.com/][u]Official Forums[/u][/url] to discuss everything Solasta.

Cheers!

notes.title: Half-Elf & Academic Background UNLOCKED! Music Upgrade & Boss Monster Vote NEXT!
notes.content:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tacticaladventures/solasta-crown-of-the-magister][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/e77f1cf50d5c7acb3f45d5d56c7eaeee91e2a7ad.png[/img][/url]

[b]Annnnnd cut! The Final Votes are:[/b]
[list][*] Backers: Half-Elf (614 - 52%) - Half Orc (559 - 48%)
[*] Discord: Half-Elf (247 - 51%) - Half-Orc (235 - 49%)
[*] Twitter: Half-Elf (51%) - Half-Orc (49%) (413 Total)
[*] Facebook: Half-Elf (57%) - Half-Orc (43%) (495 Total)[/list]
[b]Half-Elves won the battle[/b], poor Half-Orcs never stood a chance it seems. They will be the 5th Race to join Solasta: Crown of the Magister - [b]that's Stretch Goal #6 wrapped up![/b] You also unlocked the [b]Academic Background[/b] for Character Creation and its special questline!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tacticaladventures/solasta-crown-of-the-magister][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/e12a40c9bb2d3c1058f7ce3d2078c4a838844712.png[/img][/url]

[i]You had two passions growing up: history and magic. Your teachers saw your interest in all things old and magical, and ensured that your potential was nurtured. Your mission in life is to discover the secrets of the past, both magical and mundane - and you are ready to risk your life in the pursuit of discovery. You have been considering joining the Antiquarians but in the end, you wanted more freedom and didn’t want to stay in a library all day, so you took your backpack and went on to discover the wonders of Solasta by yourself.[/i]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tacticaladventures/solasta-crown-of-the-magister][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/8b8c8d94226dd21202a2313ba12e6d2987fe6a87.png[/img][/url]
[b]Now, for the upcoming Stretch Goals![/b]

[h1]Music Upgrade - Full Orchestral[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/5633c44ce1619e8f01f81a6bb36f04afec961076.png[/img]

Currently, we have planned for live musicians recordings in studio for Maxime Hervé's compositions - most often done individually. 

[b]This Stretch goal will be used to extend it to Live Orchestral recording sessions[/b]. This means not only more recordings for more variations and better interpretation, but also a greater cohesive musical ensemble to create an even more vibrant world. 

[h1]Boss Monster - Community Vote[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/f499f751343ace52b8ec785bba605bc10807a747.png[/img]

[b]Four iconic monsters, one community, one stretch goal. Which one will you choose?[/b]
[list][*] [url=https://forms.gle/6fG6F232cJ22oFmz7][u]Kickstarter[/u][/url] (Backer only)
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/fgXsHru][u]Discord[/u][/url]
[*] [u][url=https://twitter.com/tct_adventures/status/1179486592722964490]Twitter[/url][/u]
[*] [u][url=https://www.facebook.com/TacticalAdventuresGames/posts/491807441662557]Facebook[/url][/u][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/eb099bd6e497a52311edde5b98e934302f129196.png[/img]
[b]Bulette[/b] - Extremely dangerous and heavily armored, the Bulette burrows beneath the ground to snatch its prey from below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/3353a519a8a65a1567623c3a642b5546c95c263e.png[/img]
[b]Remorhaz[/b] - A gigantic beast that can grow up to 40 feet long, the Remorhaz is a monster that can produce an incredible amount of heat, easily melting any non-magical weapons that dare hit it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/f787d482c4aad96803b8125c321d7108b64c3140.png[/img]
[b]Cloaker[/b] - A stealthy creature of the dark, the Cloaker is an intelligent monster that manipulates shadows and hunts unsuspecting victims from above.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/c51ea60305d928745ef506722e76a42a47957d33.png[/img]
[b]Roper[/b] - A horrifying monster that often goes undetected until it's too late, the Roper grabs its victims with long tendrils to sap their strength, drawing them close to consume.

[h1]New Questline - Legendary Item[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/3a50557f421c49b59069c88a92b2ff1407063027.png[/img]

[i]Well well now... I have a story for you. One of power, of mystery, of a long lost item that has eluded every scavenger party so far. The stuff of legends, basically. And I happen to know about its whereabouts, for a low low sum of... Wait come back here! I swear to the gods, adventurers these days are so stingy! So, as I was saying, Legendary Item, power, yada yada yada... Are you in or what?[/i]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tacticaladventures/solasta-crown-of-the-magister][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/c68eddd0b2f0ee95529b7711cb4bea59fdc88e6a.jpg[/img]
Support us on Kickstarter![/url]

notes.title: Party Banter Feature Unlocked! Stretch Goal #4 Revealed: The Ranger is back!
notes.content:
Let's start this final week with some good news. [b]As of a few moments ago, Stretch Goal #2 - Party Banter - has now been reached! [/b]
 
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tacticaladventures/solasta-crown-of-the-magister][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/225fba06ec2c5848c05d98581a830b724c4b4a16.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/bb266f880b84de77edd5dfe339ab8de8ef814093.png[/img]
[i]Now your Rogue can be sassy even outside cutscenes![/i]
 
[i]Part of the fun of Tabletop RPGs is the "friendly" and "wholesome" remarks from your companions when you roll the dice - even more so when you fail repeatedly. It just wouldn't have the same charm without these jabs and sarcastic comments now, would it?

Well, worry not - you will now be able to experience this in Solasta: Crown of the Magister as well! The kind Cleric that encourages you to do better next time, the wholesome Paladin who tells you not to give up... Or the Rogue who simply laughs at you and tell you how much you suck. It's always the Rogue. Why is it always the Rogue.[/i]

[h1]Stretch Goal #4 - New Class: Ranger[/h1]
The polls were so close that we just couldn't leave the Ranger behind! If you haven't already, we've posted an Update with the Lore and Archetypes of the Ranger that you should read. They may not have animal companions in Solasta, but they are no less deadly! The archetypes are:
[list][*][b]Hunter (SRD)[/b] - Master of both Melee & Range combat, the Hunter is the supreme predator of the lands.
[*][b]Marksman (Solasta)[/b] - Heir to ancient archery techniques, the Marksman is the deadliest ranged combatant of Solasta. 
[*][b]Shadow Tamer (Solasta)[/b] - Wanderer of the desolated Badlands, the Shadow Tamer walks where others fear to tread.[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/80f7efa61886c503949aadef2acb5aa703cdb2af.png[/img]
 
We're still seeing questions when it comes to Physical Add-Ons and Pledge Manager, so it's time for a little reminder again!

[h1]What are Physical Rewards / Add-Ons? [/h1]
The Physical Rewards / Add-Ons refer to the four Physical Items you can order separately on top of your Pledge, which are:
[list][*]Solasta Campaign Rulebook (Hardcover) - Kickstarter Edition: 41€ / $45 approx.
[*]Solasta Campaign Rulebook (Hardcover) - Standard Edition: 32€ / $35 approx.
[*]Solasta Adventure Box: 27€ / $30 approx.
[*]Solasta Original Soundtrack Vinyl: 27€ / $30 approx.[/list]
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tacticaladventures/solasta-crown-of-the-magister][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/f86cb0f617783179a6d73d895d08514936baa9b4.png[/img][/url]
 
[h1]How do I add these to my Pledge?[/h1]
It's simple, when selecting your Pledge level just add the price of the Add-On on top of your Pledge. You can add multiple Add-Ons if you want.

[h1]When will I get to choose which Add-On I want to add?[/h1]
After the Campaign is over, you will receive an email from our Pledge Manager. The Pledge Manager will recognize which Tier you pledged for, as well as any additional funds you added on top of it - which can be used to select the Add-Ons you want.

[h1]Can I order Add-Ons directly in the Pledge Manager after the Campaign is over instead?[/h1]
Yes, but that will not contribute to the Kickstarter Stretch Goals.

[h1]When will I pay the Shipping Fees?[/h1]
We will inform you of the Shipping Fees price next year (2020) before shipping the Physical Products to your home, which is when you'll have to pay the Shipping Fees (through the Pledge Manager).
 
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tacticaladventures/solasta-crown-of-the-magister][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/c68eddd0b2f0ee95529b7711cb4bea59fdc88e6a.jpg[/img]
Support us on Kickstarter![/url]

notes.title: You did it, 100% Funded! Stretch Goals start now!
notes.content:
[h1]You people are fantastic! We reached 100%![/h1]
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tacticaladventures/solasta-crown-of-the-magister/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/cb07488cd9624da4ac347bd77d0f603f550bb478.png[/img][/url]
[i]Get yourself a drink, round's on us![/i]

[b]Thank you, thank you from the bottom of our heart.[/b] From the very start of the project, we poured the passion we had for Tabletop RPGs into Solasta: Crown of the Magister. We stayed in the dark for some time, turning a prototype into a real, solid and beautiful game - followed by working on a public Demo.

During that time, there is one question that's always in the back of every game developer's head - [b]will players like it?[/b] Then we went to [b]Gen Con[/b] this summer with the first version of the playable Demo, and the [b]tabletop crowd loved it.[/b] We went to [b]Gamescom[/b], and the [b]journalists loved it[/b]. We went to [b]Pax West[/b], and the [b]video game community[/b] loved it.

Finally, we went to Kickstarter and you guys loved it. [b]It's thanks to every last one of you that we're funded today[/b], and that we'll be able to expand beyond the initial scope of the game. As promised, these $200,000 will go towards many things, [b]the most important being more content! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/e7ec638f0bae6bbf29e8b4f559ebb233689dacfe.png[/img]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tacticaladventures/solasta-crown-of-the-magister/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/9844513e2bb24040110959202fcd450498b85dc5.png[/img][/url]
[i]Stretch Goals will be gradually revealed as we reach more and more of them! [/i]

[h1]The first Stretch Goal is the New Background: Lawkeeper![/h1]
[i]You have an instinct for spotting trouble and the force of personality to nip it in the bud. As a deputy, you learned how to spot a lie and how to discourage a troublemaker with nothing but a cold-eyed stare. And if keeping the peace and protecting the innocent requires you to break a few heads, you're ready. After some time working in law enforcement in the Principality of Masgarth, you discovered that dealing with petty criminals on a daily basis wasn’t enough for you, and you left for a different life - one of travel and discovery, hoping that your experience and personal qualities would serve you well.[/i]

[h1]The second Stretch Goal is the New Feature: Party Banter![/h1]
Part of the fun of Tabletop RPGs is the "friendly" and "wholesome" remarks from your companions when you roll the dice - even more so when you fail repeatedly. It just wouldn't have the same charm without these jabs and sarcastic comments now, would it? 

Well, worry not - you will now be able to experience this in Solasta: Crown of the Magister as well! The kind Cleric that encourages you to do better next time, the wholesome Paladin who tells you not to give up... Or the Rogue who simply laughs at you and tell you how much you suck. It's always the Rogue. Why is it always the Rogue.

[h1]The third Stretch Goal is... Thought I would tell you? You'll see soon enough![/h1]
As a reminder, the Paladin is already unlocked from reaching 100% of the Campaign Goal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/04a469cf88a76754ae809f3311a7063cf9799a36.png[/img]

As good news come in pair (wait what), we're happy to announce that [b]we've reached the first tier of the Referral Program[/b], meaning every backer gets the [b]In-Game Item: Dwarven Bread[/b]! Keep spreading the word of Solasta out there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/d09f2acd7281ccbb08d57686429d96a9dd663cdd.png[/img]
[i]Delicious (not really) AND deadly as an improvised weapon![/i]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tacticaladventures/solasta-crown-of-the-magister/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/c68eddd0b2f0ee95529b7711cb4bea59fdc88e6a.jpg[/img]
Support us on Kickstarter![/url]

notes.title: Demo Update - New Camera Options
notes.content:
Hello folks!

Many of you told us that your experience playing with the camera in the Demo was... less than stellar. Well, worry no more! [b]We're coming out with an update to the Demo, with more camera options and a few fixes.[/b]

[h1]How do I access the New Version for the Demo?[/h1]
As we don't want break everything right before the week-end, [b]we're currently rolling out the new version of our Demo on a separate branch - meaning that you will need to do some extra step to update your game.[/b] Let me guide you through them.

1. Go to your [b]Game Library[/b], and [b]right click on Solasta: Crown of the Magister Demo[/b]. Click on [b]Properties[/b].
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/b45e3ad57391e4ef51ee956ca2e5cb238e1b0073.png[/img]
 
2. Select the [b]BETAS Tab[/b]. Under "[b]Select the beta you would like to opt into[/b]", choose "[b]beta -[/b]"
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/8f138a941dd5c0164cb0ea10388beaa6271a0842.png[/img]
 
3. [b]Close Properties[/b]. The new update should now download.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
1. [b]There are now 3 different Camera Modes in the Settings Panel: [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/d80eae66571952f8ad2cf1a284d0de26a40892bc.png[/img]
 
[list][*] [b]Spring is the new default camera mode[/b]. It will follow the party around, but also allow players to move the camera around with the directional keys or simply by moving the mouse to the edge of the screen. If the player is not controlling the camera anymore, after a short time it will drag the camera back to the party. 
[*] [b]Follow is the old camera mode[/b]. It will follow the party around, and players will not be able to move it outside combat.
[*] [b]Free is the last camera mode[/b]. It allows the player to move the camera around, and will only go back to the party if the player presses "Tab" or clicks on a Character Portrait twice. 
[*] Please give the Demo another go and tell us which Camera mode you preferred![/list]
2. [b]Reaction Timer is now disabled by default[/b]. Solasta: Crown of the Magister being a Turn-Based game, quite a few of you raised the point that there is no reason to add time constraints to certain actions. Note that [b]it can be reactivated in the Settings[/b] (right above the Camera Mode selection)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/2f24dea87ce7ae61101a672892627dccfe4b254b.png[/img]
 
3. We've also fixed a couple of issues that you reported!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35306982/a06353410ba79c3eeb66df9c5847344dbe01226c.png[/img]
[i]A little doodle by our Art Director for all of our fans out there![/i]
 
[h1]Social Stretch Goals - Almost there![/h1]
Remember the Social Stretch Goal Table? Well, we're very close to reaching some of these numbers!
